findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: donation_instructions_wounded_warriors, match_donor_intent, find_foundation_prospects, lookup_va_form, get_records_access, get_family_resources, get_donate_options, get_press_kit · Private data: get_veteran_resource_stats, find_cvso, get_state_veteran_benefits, find_foundation_prospects, lookup_va_form, get_records_access, get_press_kit · Public sink: get_housing_context, find_high_housing_burden_tracts, get_congressional_district_veterans, get_family_resources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: donation_instructions_wounded_warriors, match_donor_intent, find_foundation_prospects, lookup_va_form, get_records_access, get_family_resources, get_donate_options, get_press_kit · Private data: get_veteran_resource_stats, find_cvso, get_state_veteran_benefits, find_foundation_prospects, lookup_va_form, get_records_access, get_press_kit · Public sink: get_housing_context, find_high_housing_burden_tracts, get_congressional_district_veterans, get_family_resources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
